text: The message is written in rows, its columns shuffled by one puzzle word, and again by a second, then enciphered on the table with a repeating key: 15,376 routes.
For each route, the shortest key length the known letters allow. The floor is 23, lower than with one shuffle, but the key fragments there read as noise.
The best key run on the copper scores below the best on one of the ten shuffled coppers. Double shuffles of this kind are chance.
